up: Retrieve the exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation) and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649961. Join activities with compound_structures via molregno to get the SMILES. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961'. Return distinct rows based on activity_id to ensure unique activity records. Do not apply any additional filters on activity type, units, or relation.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649961'
